content: Statamic Global Sets: named sets of fields, optionally given a blueprint (needed as soon as you want a real fieldtype rather than plain text); one CP screen per set; templates read them under the set handle ({{ footer:copyright }}); localized per site. Craft Globals: global sets each with a field layout, Settings > Globals to define, a Globals nav section to edit, templates read {{ companyInfo.yearEstablished }}; per-site translation.
